d: Debutant Yash Thakur joins Ajay Jadeja and the Extraaa Innings panel live from Mount Maunganui after a memorable ODI debut against New Zealand! Watch him open up about getting the nod from head coach Gautam Gambhir, fighting through sleepless nights and early nerves, defending a low total of 209, and how key tactical inputs from Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, and Mohammed Siraj helped set up his maiden international wicket.
